summary: This Form 8-K by Blue Owl Technology Income Corp. reports two routine items: an unregistered sale of 278,351 Class I shares for $2.7 million to feeder vehicles under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation S, and declaration of a monthly distribution of $0.074775 per share across classes. The filing also provides an update on its continuous public offering of up to $5.0 billion in shares, with total issued consideration of $4.06 billion as of the filing date. No pricing, premium, or terms justify classification as a special situation; these are ordinary capital-raising and dividend disclosure events.
